verdict.rationale: The only story-specific evidence is indirect. A community note says GitLab's GitHub importer brings over issues and milestones, which implies GitLab has a native milestone concept. First-party copy mentions planning, and another community note praises its issue tracking, but nothing documents grouping issues into milestones or setting due dates. missing for 10: first-party documentation of milestones, evidence of assigning issues to milestones, evidence of milestone due dates, hands-on corroboration.
